## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour change
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (_Unreleased_) updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No new permission, or [docs/PRIVACY.md](../docs/PRIVACY.md) is updated and the permission explained
